supporting_observations.claim: User maria.lopez opened a Word document named 'Statement.docm' from the Downloads folder.
Microsoft Word spawned a PowerShell process with a hidden window and a base64 encoded command.
The encoded PowerShell command downloads and executes a script from raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1.
The PowerShell process initiated a connection to the organizational proxy to download the script.
PowerShell spawned rundll32.exe to load a DLL from the user's AppData folder (svchelper.dll).

claims_not_established: The full contents and impact of the downloaded script 'u.ps1' and the 'svchelper.dll' are not visible in the logs.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve and analyze u.ps1 and svchelper.dll for malware analysis.
unrelated_findings: PowerShell activity from SYSTEM running endpoint-inventory.ps1 via taskeng.exe (T023-00165)
PowerShell process (T023-00168) attempting to use svc-bkp credentials to access PROXY-HD-01
